# EPIC

> EPIC is a free visual sitemap builder and design tool. Plan website structure, export developer-ready JSON sitemaps, and create professional graphics — built for founders, developers, and UX designers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Visual sitemap builder and design platform overview.
- [Sitemap Builder](/navigation-maker): Drag-and-drop visual sitemap maker with UX scoring and JSON/PNG export.
- [Website Analyzer](/analyzer): Crawl any site and generate a visual sitemap automatically.
- [Sitemap Library](/sitemaps): Public gallery of community-shared website sitemaps.
- [Examples](/examples): Real sitemap examples across industries.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on UX, sitemap design, and website planning.
- [Pricing (India)](/pricing-india): INR plans with UPI checkout for Indian users.
- [Pricing (International)](/pricing-international): USD plans for global users.
- [About](/about): What EPIC is and who it's for.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the EPIC team.
- [Roadmap](/roadmap): Upcoming features.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Recent product updates.

## India-focused landing pages

- [Sitemap Builder India](/sitemap-builder-india): Sitemap builder optimized for Indian founders and agencies.
- [Website Planner for Students (India)](/website-planner-for-students-india): For Indian university students planning websites.
- [SaaS Tools India](/saas-tools-india): SaaS planning tools with INR pricing.
